items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Glenn Campbell; the interviewer mentions Glenn Campbell in relation to Eddie Miller.

ctx.x: Yeah. We really enjoyed on that every night. We pick each other's skulls, you see. And he gets involved sometimes. Sometimes it's wrong, but it's more joy.

I don't know how many people are aware that Eddie made Glenn Campbell famous. He put Glenn on a record with him overnight, right? Six months, he was the number one star. That's true. That's right. Do you have another album in the works, Eddie?
